categories.main_business_segments: Midea Real Estate Holding Limited operates primarily in four business segments: project management services, property management services, asset operation (including commercial properties and industrial parks), and real estate technology. The company divested its property development and sales business in 2024 to focus on these light-asset segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes building industrialization and real estate technology, including design technology, prefabricated concrete components (PC components), modular integrated construction (MiC), green low-carbon materials, and smart home products. It integrates digitalization, industrialization, and green technologies to provide full lifecycle building solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Midea Real Estate serves a diverse customer base including residential property owners, industrial parks, medical care and wellness facilities, and commercial property tenants. It also targets public hospitals, schools, and enterprises requiring project management and property services, with a focus on the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and expanding into overseas developed markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in Mainland China, especially in Guangdong Province (Foshan, Shunde), and has expanded into Hong Kong and overseas developed countries. Key cities include Foshan, Guiyang, Zhuzhou, Handan, and Shenzhen, with a strategic focus on the Greater Bay Area.
categories.supply_chain_position: Midea Real Estate operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate value chain, focusing on project management, property management, asset operation, and real estate technology services rather than heavy asset property development. It provides integrated services post-construction and asset operation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes technological innovation in building industrialization, green and low-carbon materials, smart home technologies, and digital solutions. It focuses on product excellence, sustainable development, and expanding its real estate technology business, particularly the MiC modular construction system, while deepening its presence in the Greater Bay Area and overseas markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through service fees from property management, asset operation income from commercial and industrial properties, project management service fees, and sales of real estate technology products and solutions. The company also earns income from consulting, government grants, and other ancillary services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Midea Real Estate is ranked among the top property service companies in China, including Top 18 in property service strength and Top 22 in comprehensive strength. It positions itself as a leading smart healthy life service provider with strong capabilities in property management, industrial park services, and real estate technology, competing with other major Chinese property service firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group reported RMB 3.73 billion revenue from continuing operations, a 33.3% increase year-on-year, with a net profit of RMB 486 million from continuing operations. The company has a net cash position of RMB 467.56 million as of year-end 2024, reflecting a transition to a lighter asset business model and steady growth in service segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Midea Real Estate emphasizes high-quality, green, energy-saving, and healthy building solutions combined with comprehensive property and asset management services. Its differentiation lies in integrating technology-driven real estate solutions, modular construction, and a diversified service ecosystem covering residential, industrial, and medical sectors, supported by strong brand reputation and craftsmanship.
